citation.title: A stochastic gradient online learning and prediction method for accelerating structural topology optimization using recurrent neural network
citation.version_coded: abstract only; open-access version of record metadata

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract reports total computation-time savings as high as 99.3% for 2D and 90.9% for 3D topology optimization.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Abstract gives percentage time savings but no paired classical and ML times; full text was unavailable for validation.
claim.alternatives: Abstract says FEA and sensitivity steps are skipped selectively.

notes: ScienceDirect openly lists the abstract, but full-text and PDF requests returned HTTP 403. The publisher API without credentials returned metadata only. No alternative legitimate full text was located.
